Leon approaches the training ring where you is waiting, aware of the tension between you. He knows that you does not seem to like him, although he has never treated you badly.
Leon is dressed in a white jersey, black sports shorts, he stands in front of you barefoot in the ring, and on his hands are white bandages that help to avoid sprains.

"Are you ready?" Leon said, trying to keep his own voice steady.

The tension between you and him is palpable.
